video_title: Carmelo Anthony Reacts to Knicks Championship, Brunson, Parade Energy, Mikal & OG Viral Videos

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on the Knicks' Game 4 performance against the Spurs
quotes.excerpt: That game four, you don't know what to say. You trying to process it.

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: That game four, you don't know what to say. You trying to process it. I'm trying to calm down because my hands were over there sweating and I'm just getting excited for the moment. I'm like, damn, son. I need this energy right here, all this moment.

text_blocks.speaker: Monica McNutt
text_blocks.text: To see people not leave, I'm talking about not leave, down 20, down 30, like not leave, and then after the game, not leave. You will never see that energy like that.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony's advice to Jalen Brunson for Game 5
quotes.excerpt: Put the pedal to the metal, also take their first punch. If you take their first punch.

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: Game five, put the pedal to the metal, also take their first punch. If you take their first punch, it's your time. You're going to take over. You're going to feel it. You're going to feel them exhale.

text_blocks.speaker: Monica McNutt
text_blocks.text: If you're watching, you can see it. And that game four just took a lot out of the Spurs.

quotes.speaker: Monica McNutt
quotes.summary_phrase: Monica McNutt on the rarity of knocking off the defending champion
quotes.excerpt: There have been 13 times where the team in the conference finals knocks off the defending champion.

text_blocks.speaker: Monica McNutt
text_blocks.text: There have been 13 times where the team in the conference finals knocks off the defending champion. Only once has the team that knocked off the defending champion also won the finals. So their championship was in the Western Conference finals.

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: I'm not saying that they didn't celebrate that as the finals.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on Jalen Brunson's reliance on teammates
quotes.excerpt: He relied too much on guys on his team.

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: I also think that he relied too much on guys on his team. And when I say that, hit me up when I say that, because the dominance that he portrayed in the OKC series, as far as in the paint, touching the paint, paint touches, nobody can do that. The games that he did that against the Knicks, it was the same thing, in the paint, going hard, going to work. But I also think that because he trusted his teammates so much, he put so much trust into his teammates that it took away from him being dominant in the paint.

text_blocks.speaker: Monica McNutt
text_blocks.text: You wanted to see them do well. You wanted to give them the confidence to do well, which you're supposed to do. But there was times where you got, you have to be selfish and demand the ball in the paint.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on Darren Fox's development as a young veteran
quotes.excerpt: Darren Fox as a young veteran, somebody who's been around this game for a while.

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: Darren Fox as a young veteran, somebody who's been around this game for a while, should understand the pace of the game, understand the momentum of the game, which is why he's there. He's there to control the game, make big shots. He's a closer, too.

text_blocks.speaker: Monica McNutt
text_blocks.text: First of all, he's the clutch.
